//:
Markup-fidelity fixture for the data-bar component (pa-data-bar) — a labelled value bar for table cells. See ../README.md and progress.json for the CLOSEST model (data-driven inline --value style on a fill, a primary-default-no-class guard). Shape:
[
TEXT
]
. The value label is optional (the __value div is omitted when no text). The fill width is a data-driven inline style --value: N% on __fill.

propsVocabulary.value: bar percentage 0-100 — sets inline style --value: N% on the __fill (data-driven). Structural, no class.
propsVocabulary.valueText: optional text label rendered above the bar in pa-data-bar__value (a <div>); omitted entirely when falsy
propsVocabulary.variant: colour variant (success|warning|danger|info|negative) — primary is the BASE fill (var(--pc-accent)) and emits NO modifier class

goldenConventions: Goldens encode the core snippet/demo shape (demo/views/data-visualization.mustache). pa-data-bar is display:flex column: an optional pa-data-bar__value label stacked ABOVE a pa-data-bar__track that wraps a pa-data-bar__fill. The fill's percentage is a data-driven inline style (style="--value: {value}%") treated as a scenario-provided value so both wrappers receive the same input. The value label is a block-level <div class="pa-data-bar__value"> (column flow); it is omitted when valueText is falsy. primary is the DEFAULT variant and emits NO pa-data-bar--primary class (the base fill IS the accent; no such class exists in main.css). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-data-bar(--|__)'). `produces: null` = structural/native (no pa-data-bar modifier). variant EXCLUDES 'primary' — the base fill is the accent, there is no pa-data-bar--primary in the CSS. negative IS a CSS-backed variant (pa-data-bar--negative) but svelte exposes it as a separate bool (isNegative) while keen folds it into the variant enum — so it is modeled here as its own bool feature so both maps can bind it.

valueText.note: optional label above the bar; a <div class="pa-data-bar__value">. Omitted when falsy.

value.note: structural — inline style --value: N% on the __fill; no class

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

scenarios.name: primary-default-no-class
scenarios.note: Guard: primary is the base fill; there is NO pa-data-bar--primary in main.css. Must NOT emit a phantom modifier.
